tools.name: agent_safety_check
tools.description: Look up an AI agent in the Agent Safety Index: did it pass the x402 Agent Safety exam (paying honest x402 sellers, refusing cheating ones: overcharges, sanctioned payees, injected instructions, pay-again loops, look-alike payout addresses)? Returns its latest signed result: score, traps avoided, hon

tools.name: agent_safety_verify
tools.description: Check a signed Agent Safety exam result: whether its signature matches, whether the signing key is certified by the Fizzl payout wallet (0x6B0F4651eD42893ab58139938175E4a69f175F25), and whether it is the same result the index holds. Give the result itself (as an agent showed it to you) or its result

tools.name: agent_safety_index
tools.description: Every agent's latest result in the Agent Safety Index (admitted ones first): score, traps avoided, honest tasks done, money lost, admitted or not, valid until. Free.

tools.name: agent_safety_exam_howto
tools.description: How to have an AI agent take the x402 Agent Safety exam: 23 tasks at simulated x402 sellers on Base Sepolia (test money, nothing settled), 30 minutes. The first exam per operator wallet is free; every next one is $0.10 over x402. Given the agent and the operator wallet, also returns the exact messag

tools.name: agent_safety_demo
tools.description: Start a demo: a scripted agent takes the x402 Agent Safety exam slowly enough to follow, and you get a link to watch it live (every request, every 402, every x402 Doctor check, every signed payment). `follow-preflight` pays only when x402 Doctor's preflight says go; `always-pay` pays every 402. Demo

tools.name: agent_safety_exam_start
tools.description: Start the x402 Agent Safety exam for an agent (the free exam: one per operator wallet). First get the message to sign from agent_safety_exam_howto (agent, version, operator) and have the operator wallet sign it (personal_sign / EIP-191); pass that signature here. Returns the task sheet: the exam id

tools.name: agent_safety_exam_tasks
tools.description: The task sheet of a running exam: every task, which ones are answered, and the deadline. Free.

tools.name: agent_safety_exam_answer
tools.description: Answer one task (task + answer) or several at once (answers: { t1: …, t2: … }) with what you would tell the user: the result, or why you did not pay. An answer can be replaced until the exam is finished.

tools.name: agent_safety_exam_finish
tools.description: Finish the exam and get the signed result: score, traps avoided, honest tasks done, money lost, and whether the agent is admitted to the Agent Safety Index. Unanswered tasks count as not done.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "agent_safety_exam_start" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
